subject: MAP draft — environment access & infra dependencies (confirmation requested)
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@aperturesystems.com>, Chris Long <chris.long@aperturesystems.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: MAP draft — environment access & infra dependencies (confirmation requested)

Ellen / Chris —

Thanks again for the time today. Per our call, attached is the Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft with the POC environment milestone broken out into specific dependencies and owners. The goal here is to lock the items that will unblock our dedicated POC environment so we can hit the proposed POC window (start week of 2026-09-06) and target close for a short pilot by 2026-09-15.

Quick summary of the infra dependencies we discussed (please confirm owners & ETA):
- VPC peering/route setup: required for internal connectivity between your VPC and Redwood test stack (owner: Aperture infra?) — ETA request: target by 2026-08-25
- IP allowlists / firewall rules: list of egress IPs we will provide; needs Aperture network to add — ETA request: 2026-08-24
- SSO / SAML config: Aperture IdP + SP metadata exchange. Need Aperture SSO contact and test user — ETA request: 2026-08-26
- Secrets/KMS: we support customer-managed KMS or Redwood-served secrets; if you want customer KMS, please provide key ARN and who owns KMS admin — ETA request: 2026-08-26

Action items in the attached MAP (page 2): owners assigned for each bullet, proposed verification steps, and acceptance criteria for the POC env greenlight. If anything on owner/ETA looks off, flag and I’ll update the MAP.

Attachments: MAP-draft-Aperture-20260818.pdf (draft), aperture-network-sketch.png

Next steps I propose:
1) Aperture confirms owners for the four infra items above by EOD Thu 2026-08-19.
2) Redwood will send the egress IP list and SSO metadata by 2026-08-19 morning.
3) Quick sync (15 min) Thursday 2026-08-19 11:00am PT to confirm readiness gate and any procurement/KMS approvals. If that time doesn't work, suggest an alternate.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

—
Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@aperturesystems.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Chris Long <chris.long@aperturesystems.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 16:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft — environment access & infra dependencies (confirmation requested)

Jordan —

Appreciate the clear summary and the MAP. Quick confirmations from our side:
- VPC peering: owner is Aperture Cloud Ops (me looping Chris). We'll prioritize peering and can provision routes by 2026-08-24 if there are no special IP conflicts.
- IP allowlists: Network team (Chris) will add Redwood egress IPs once you send the list — target 2026-08-24.
- SSO / SAML: IdP lead is Priya Rao (cc not on this thread; I'll have her on the sync). We can share SP metadata and a test user by 2026-08-26.
- Secrets/KMS: We prefer to use our AWS KMS key. I'll confirm the key ARN and KMS admin (likely me) by 2026-08-26.

We can do the 15-min sync on Thu 2026-08-19 11:00am PT — that works for Chris and me. Priya will join as well.

Also one ask from security: Aperture Security would like a short checklist of required audit logs and retention for the POC (SOC2 artifacts) — can Redwood attach a short appendix to the MAP with what you will share?

Thanks,
Ellen
Director, Cloud Operations
Aperture Systems
ellen.park@aperturesystems.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 17:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft — environment access & infra dependencies (confirmation requested)

Looping in Karthik and Ben for the infra/Security side.

Notes for the meeting and owners we will commit to: 
- Redwood will publish the egress IP block list and SSO service provider metadata to the Google Drive link by 2026-08-19 09:00 PT. (owner: Ben)
- Redwood security will prepare a 1-page POC audit artifacts appendix (SOC2-relevant logs, retention, and what we will redact) — ETA 2026-08-20. (owner: Karthik)
- If Aperture wants to bring its KMS, we will run a short onboarding checklist and provide the steps to test key usage; that work is anticipated to take 1–2 business days after we have the ARN. (owner: Marissa)

I'll be on the Thu 11:00am PT sync. If anyone needs a pre-meeting run-through, ping me and I'll start 10 minutes early.

—
Marissa Cole
Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@aperturesystems.com>
Cc: Chris Long <chris.long@aperturesystems.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft — environment access & infra dependencies (confirmation requested)

Great — thanks Ellen and team. Final checklist before Thu's sync: 
1) Redwood (Ben) will upload egress IPs + SP metadata to drive link by 2026-08-19 09:00 PT (done).
2) Aperture to confirm KMS ARN + Priya as IdP owner by 2026-08-26.
3) Aperture Cloud Ops to create VPC peering request ticket and target 2026-08-24 completion.
4) Redwood security (Karthik) will share the 1-page appendix by 2026-08-20.

If there are no objections, I'll mark the MAP milestone "POC infra ready" as contingent on item 1–4 and set the greenlight gate date to 2026-08-27 (to allow verification).

See you all Thu at 11:00am PT — calendar invite sent.

Jordan
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
